children: Gate lists Clearpool's CLEAR token on its spot market. The listing pairs CLEAR with USDT.

The pair gives traders on a major exchange direct access to CLEAR. Gate users who hold USDT can use that balance to buy CLEAR. A spot purchase gives the buyer the token itself. Traders who hold CLEAR can use the same pair to sell it and receive USDT.

title: Clearpool: Gate lists CLEAR for spot trading against USDT - 27 Nov 2026
